name: Zum Hirschen
kurzbeschreibung: **At The Deer** in **Längenfeld** – a cozy mountain inn where hearty Tyrolean dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Speckknödel** are served with a view of the **Ötztal Alps**. Try their famous **Tiroler Gröstl** or a warming bowl of **Käsespätzle** after a day of hiking in the **Venter Valley**. A true taste of **Tirol**’s alpine hospitality.
